file.description: Every look and sound the showcase has: items, blocks, menus, glyphs, tooltips, armour and the HUD

json.credit: A ruby crystal: a tall shard with two leaning beside it
The ruby crystal, glowing: its shards a little taller, drawn at full light
A throwing dart, pointing along +Z: steel point, birch shaft, gold band, red flights
The owl's body: a feathered barrel with a cream front, a tail and two feet
The owl's head, eyes open (they glow): it turns about the neck at the model's middle
The owl's head with its eyes shut, for blinking
One wing, hanging from the shoulder at the model's middle
